full_details: You took the parish hour at St Helen's with the almanac open and added nothing to the printed date. A man's back in the mayor's pew did not turn. From eleven you were in the lodging. At four Mistress Ansell set down peas boiled to nothing, a sop of bread in warm ale, and a baked apple, and you complained of the texture of each. Alse began a riddle and was stopped before the answer. Master Verbeke finished the sound of it in his own tongue and would not put it into English. You laughed, held the jaw, and found that laughing was not what hurt. She had already said evening prayer at the table. You were to be in bed by eight. The jaw woke you in the night.
one_sentence: You sat morning prayer, and at four you ate peas, a sop, and a baked apple, and laughed with a hand on the jaw.
title: Ate soft food, and laughed
